title: festuca drymeja f. lucorum
intro: Festuca drymeja f. lucorum, commonly known as a type of grass, is a species of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues. Festuca drymeja f. lucorum is also reported to have therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
